design_philosophy: High-Contrast Premium Sports UI. A departure from the dark navy/purple clones. We are building a 'Day-Night Test Match' / 'Premium Turf' vibe. It should feel like an elite, high-stakes sports trading floor, focusing on extreme data clarity, trust (emerald green), and kinetic energy (blaze orange).

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, contest titles, and large metric numbers. Keep tracking tight (`tracking-tight`).

body.usage: Use for all body copy, forms, table data, and descriptions.
body.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-zinc-500

primary.description: Emerald Green. Used for primary CTAs (Join, Pay, Deposit) to signal trust and money.

secondary.description: Blaze Orange. Used for kinetic actions, alerts, live status, and withdrawal highlights.

user_dashboard.structure: Top navigation bar (white surface, 1px border bottom) + Bento grid main content area.
user_dashboard.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 for main containers. Generous breathing room.

admin_dashboard.structure: Collapsible left sidebar + main content area. High density data tables.
admin_dashboard.spacing: Tight padding (p-4 to p-6) to maximize data visibility.

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces. `bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-lg`. NO drop shadows to maintain a sharp, technical look.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or slightly rounded (`rounded-md`) but keep it consistent. Use sharp `font-bold` text. Primary buttons must use Emerald Green.
components.inputs: Shadcn default `Input` and `Select`, customized with `focus:ring-emerald-500` and `border-zinc-200`.
components.badges: Use solid light backgrounds with dark text for status. e.g. Pending = `bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded`.
components.modals: Shadcn `Dialog`. Use for UPI screenshot upload and Withdrawal requests. Ensure a clean file upload zone with dashed borders (`border-dashed border-2 border-zinc-300`).
components.tabs: Shadcn `Tabs`. Customize the active state to have a bold bottom border (`border-b-2 border-emerald-600`) or a solid pill background, avoiding generic grey.
components.tables: Admin panel tables must use Shadcn `Table`. Include subtle alternating row colors (`even:bg-zinc-50`) or solid lines (`border-b border-zinc-100`) for readability.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px `zinc-200` borders aggressively to separate sections instead of using different background shades or shadows.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use `@phosphor-icons/react` (Duotone weight for marketing/empty states, Regular for dense data/admin).
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Add `group-hover:text-emerald-600` on card titles when hovering the parent card. Add `active:scale-95` on all primary buttons.

images.description: Vibrant cricket match at Narendra Modi Stadium with a packed crowd.
images.usage: Landing page hero background. Apply `bg-black/60` overlay for text contrast.
User dashboard promo banner or empty state illustration.
Winners announcement section or leaderboard header.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images uses proper overlays. Standard text must meet 4.5:1 ratio against background.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 focus-visible:outline-none`.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add `data-testid` to all forms, buttons, links, and status badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React (Vite) + Tailwind + Shadcn application.
Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Roboto' for headings. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body copy.
Do NOT use dark purple/violet gradients. Stick to the crisp white, zinc, emerald green, and blaze orange palette.
Create a clean User Dashboard with tabs (Contests, My Entries, Wallet).
Create a separate Admin Dashboard layout with a sidebar (Users, Contests, Payments, Withdrawals).
For the UPI Payment flow: Users click 'Join' -> Modal opens showing Admin UPI ID -> User uploads screenshot -> Status changes to Pending -> Admin approves -> External Link becomes visible to user.
Ensure the hero section on the landing page uses the provided stadium image with a proper dark overlay so the white text pops.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for headers/navbars if content scrolls under them. Use `bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b`.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align dense content.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., p-6 or p-8 for cards).
Apply transition states ONLY to interactive elements (`transition-colors`, `transition-transform`), NOT universal `transition-all` on everything.
Use modern button styles (sharp or pill) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) as icons. Use the Phosphor icon library.
Ensure all components use the requested `data-testid` for testing.
Always add `data-testid` attributes to interactive and key informational elements.
